title: Istanbul Ottoman Heritage & Sweet Flavors
summary: A 2-day trip for a couple in their 30s who love Orhan Pamuk, Sami Yusuf, Ottoman history, calligraphy, coffee and sweets. Day 1 explores Sultanahmet’s historic core with palaces, mosques and traditional cafés. Day 2 crosses to Kadıköy for literary spots, waterfront views and contemporary cafés, all with halal food and convenient prayer times.

stops.address: Cankurtaran Babı Hümayun Cad No: 1 34122 Fatih/İstanbul Türkiye

tips: Purchase an Istanbulkart for easy access to trams, ferries and buses between Sultanahmet and Kadıköy.
Verify prayer times locally and arrive at mosques 10-15 minutes early for ablution and seating.
Many cafés and restaurants in Sultanahmet and Kadıköy offer Turkish delight and baklava—perfect for satisfying your sweet tooth.
